title: A New Level Set Formulation for Improved Dirichlet Eigenvalue Minimizers
summary: This paper makes several improvements to existing level set based approaches to computing shape optimizers for the Dirichlet eigenvalues subject to a volume constraint. The most notable changes in formulation include an overhaul of the classical level set construction and root-finding procedures as well the use of a regularized approximation to the standard objective function. Our resulting computational minimizers are either comparable to or improvements on the best known minimizers from the literature.
